AskUserQuestion renders as its real question and options, not raw JSON
why: describeCall has no file_path/path/pattern/url to key on for this tool, so it falls to JSON.stringify(input).slice(0,200) — the raw, truncated dump the screenshot shows. Answering it also has no clean channel yet: agent.ts never rewrites updatedInput on allow (by design, so a Bash call isn't silently changed), and there is no separate 'answer' field in the control protocol we use.

card werk-mc-asks  [decided]
Blink the tab dot for a pending ask. The '...' button blinks too, for any tab it hides.
why: There is one ask bar and one Asks instance. A second child would block on a question nobody can see.
subtree: 2 cards, 2 decided, 1 stale

Rejected: a shared queue where the ask appears inline in whatever tab is focused (see
werk-mc-asks:opt2). Eryk built and tested it. It interrupts the tab you are reading, and
the chip names only the tab, not the question, so you cannot tell if it is worth stopping
for.

Decided: the ask stays on its own tab. The tab chip shows it, not the pane you are
looking at.

1. The idle-tab dot changes to signal a pending ask: blink yellow for waiting on input,
   blink red for an error.
2. The '...' menu button (see werk-mc-park) aggregates every tab it hides, plus every
   visible tab that is not the current one: blink yellow if any of them is yellow, red if
   any of them is red. Red wins if both are true. The current tab's own state never drives
   the button — you are already looking at it.

Enter/Escape acting on 'the head of the queue' (previously point 4) no longer applies —
there is no shared queue. Each tab's ask is answered on that tab.

Checked the trace with `werk show`. Two inherited stale marks, both false positives:

1. **From #werk-mc-tabs** (2 hops) — card #werk-mc-askqa was created *after* that reopen (seq 1230 vs. #werk-mc-tabs's correction). This is exactly the "born after" case #vi-prop-bornstale documents: the mark is inherited, not a sign of error.

2. **From #werk-mc-asks direct edge** — the reopen (seq 1238) happened 2 minutes after #werk-mc-askqa was created, so it does predate this one. But that reopen only rejected the shared-queue alternative in favor of per-tab ask blinking — it says nothing about how a single AskUserQuestion call renders or how the answer travels back to the model. #werk-mc-askqa's later build notes (seq 1246–1249) implement the answer channel over `Asks.answer/put`, written *after* the reopen and consistent with the per-tab design. The content was never in conflict.

Clearing it.
